text:
[issue by Nhantaa]
you have created version 1.21, but is version 1.20.6 compatible with version 1.21?

[comment by imeesa (none)]
The version for 1.20.6 won't run on 1.21, it just wasn't made for it.

[comment by Nhantaa (none)]
> The version for 1.20.6 won't run on 1.21, it just wasn't made for it.

In that case, why create version 1.21 before version 1.20.6? It makes no sense.

[comment by imeesa (none)]
> In that case, why create version 1.21 before version 1.20.6? It makes no sense.
Because more people want it.

[comment by MimzyFang (none)]
> > The version for 1.20.6 won't run on 1.21, it just wasn't made for it.
> 
> In that case, why create version 1.21 before version 1.20.6? It makes no sense.

1.21 was released 1 month after 1.20.6 so a lot of mods did not brother with updating to 1.20.6 and just skipped it

[comment by HIM049 (none)]
But looks this mod with version 1.20.4 cannot working on 1.20.6? Because my server is crashed when try to load it.

[comment by yungnickyoung (member)]
Sorry, my mods don't support 1.20.6 and we're not planning on porting to it due to time constraints.
